{{Quote|Not yet, Padawan. Something more appropriate for a planet run by merchants. Old-style aurodium credits. Three billion's worth, in several large ingots.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Rogue Planet" />}}
'''Ingots''' were masses of precious or semi-precious metal cast into convenient, generally oblong shapes for storage or transportation. They could be used as currency or currency reserve.

==History==
In the days of old, [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Republican Credits]] took the form of pure [[Aurodium/Legends|aurodium]] ingots. In the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], those ingots were still used when a great amount of money was needed for trade. When [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was sent to [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] in order to buy one of the planet's [[Sekotan Personal Starship|living ships]] in [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], he was given ten of these ingots for trade.<ref name="Rogue Planet" />

Piles of ingots, neatly stacked inside [[acceleration webbing]], were found in the treasure room of the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] [[Vagaari plunder ship|plunder ship]] after it was captured by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] in the [[Skirmish in the Crustai system|skirmish between the Chiss and Vagaari]] in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
